species_selection_basis: species is explicitly listed in dataset metadata
independent conspecific mark-recapture/telemetry literature supports pond-to-pond and inter-basin movement at multiple spatial scales
legacy R analysis code is not an admissible justification for species selection

geometry.coordinate_rule: median 2012 UTMe and UTMn per site

scale_selection.rationale: fixed response-independently from external Rana cascadae movement literature spanning common hundreds-of-meters movements, >1 km dispersal, inter-basin dispersal around 0.8-1.6 km, and documented movements up to about 5.2 km

sources.citation: Garwood 2009, Spatial ecology of the Cascades frog
Garwood & Welsh 2007, Ecology of the Cascades frog

response_construction.site_use_rule: 1 if any RACA observation count is >0 across valid visits; 0 if at least two valid surveys occurred and no RACA observation is >0; otherwise non-estimable
response_construction.life_stage_restriction: none; species-level site use across all recorded life stages
response_construction.claim_term: observed site use, not latent true occupancy

feature_definitions.generic_pond_reachability_fraction_acros: fraction of frozen radii with >=1 other 2012 pond within radius
feature_definitions.generic_pond_pressure_mean_across_scale_: mean over radii of sum over other 2012 ponds exp(-distance/radius)
feature_definitions.occupied_source_reachability_fraction_ac: fraction of frozen radii with >=1 other 2012 RACA-positive source within radius
feature_definitions.occupied_source_pressure_mean_across_sca: mean over radii of sum over other 2012 RACA-positive sources exp(-distance/radius)

evaluation.training_class_gate: at least 5 positive and 5 negative 2013 targets in training after endpoint applicability filtering
evaluation.model: L2 logistic regression, C=1, training-only numeric standardization
evaluation.numeric_missing_rule: training-fold median imputation with missingness indicator

stage1_authorization_requirements: no scale, species, reference or split changes after Stage 1
stage2_authorization_requirements: all feature construction complete without 2013 target
prohibited: use legacy R code to alter species/reference/scale
select one radius after seeing 2012 or 2013 responses
use 2013 response to choose source anchors
promote PNW to pristine fresh evidence
use PNW result to alter frozen A-Islands/Tanzania manuscript
